content.body:
Based on the outstanding performance of the earlier Daimler Scout Car, an up armored and upgunned version was developed. Bearing the turret of the Tetrarch light tank, the Daimler Mk.I had an armament equivalent to most medium tanks of the early war years. It was very mobile and fast off road which gave it the perfect performance profile for an advanced scout.
Control Variations: Driver spawns in buttoned but may zoom on open viewslit (numpad . or Del key). No periscope. Gunner has no view slit or range adjustment (gradations only). AP ammunition only.
The Daimler is an exceptional armored car in Battleground Europe. It's armed with a gun that can easily kill all early panzers and capable of much better off road speed, its only weakness is its light armor. Driving the Daimler, you can kill enemy tanks, but remember that you cannot forever fight them: your armor will not withstand any sustained gunnery duel with even a light tank, so don't be seduced by all that firepower into thinking you are invincible. You are an armored car.
Use your good speed to go out and around enemy forces, there is no reason to get stuck in a gunfight when you can move around to fight at your better advantage as a sneaky and highly mobile ambush unit. Come from unexpected directions; lie in wait on resupply roads to kill any reinforcements. Its worth considering always keeping your commander popped out for maximum situational awareness: if you hear a vehicle coming from a direction you don't expect, just leave.
Because it is such a dangerous vehicle in smart hands, you should expect that the Germans will not hesitate to send tactical aircraft or allocate specific forces to killing any Daimler observed poking around or behind their lines.
content.brief: TYPE: Armoured Car ARMAMENT: 40mm Main Gun (QF.2pdr) 1 x .303 inch MG HP: 110 WEIGHT: 7514 kg SPEED (road): 72 km/h
content.title: Daimler Mk.I Scout Car
